# **Gaps — no SOP yet**

- **Member Onboarding** – no standardised journey from sign-up to first class to retention checkpoint (critical for churn prevention)
- **Member Checklins** – no cadence or framework for proactive outreach post-join (esp. post-class 1, week 2, month 1)
- **Cancellation & Churn** – no documented exit interview, win-back sequence, or offboarding; leakage likely unmeasured
- **Class Quality Audit Checklist** – no consistency mechanism for coach performance, class safety, or member experience standards
- **Coaching Development Roadmap** – no progression framework, skills ladder, or feedback loop for coach growth
- **Member data privacy & GDPR** – no data handling, consent, retention, or breach protocol (legal/compliance risk)
- **Referral Programme** – no mechanics, incentive structure, or tracking process (easy revenue lever unused)
- **Member Outcomes tracking** – no system to log/measure progress, goals hit, or ROI to member (retention gold)
- **Troubleshooting Guide** – no first-line resolution playbook for common member complaints, cancellations, or facility issues

---

# **Needs updating**

- **Weekly Key Coach Tasks** – likely missing: safety briefing, class feedback review, member name recall prep, injury/modification log review
- **Milestone Achievements** – probably exists but disconnected from outcomes tracking and member comms (no celebratory/retention trigger)
- **30 Day Goals** – needs alignment with onboarding cadence and coach accountability for goal-setting quality
- **Marketing SOPs** – no clear handoff from campaign → sign-up → onboarding team (leakage at conversion stage)
- **Facilities SOPs** – assume no deep-clean/equipment maintenance

# Service Menu Execution for The Forge

**Audit ruthlessly first:**
Before writing anything, spend 2 hours documenting *exactly* what coaches currently sell (classes, PT rates, packages, add-ons, nutrition, assessments). You'll find inconsistency — that's your problem. Fix the offer before documenting it.

**Create two versions, one truth:**
Build ONE master service menu in a shared doc (Google Sheets works). Column 1 = service name. Column 2 = price. Column 3 = what's included (be brutally specific — "12 sessions" not "package"). Column 4 = member tier eligibility (if tiered). Coaches reference this. Members see a cleaned-up version (remove internal cost notes).

**Price anchoring move:**
Don't just list prices — show the "before" value stacked up. Example: "1-on-1 PT session (£60) includes: form check, custom warmup, nutrition tip = normally £85 value." This justifies rate to hesitant members and stops coaches discounting.

**Publish on three surfaces immediately:**
(1) Printed laminated card at front desk + in changing rooms. (2) Simple PDF email to all members this week. (3) One-pager for coaches to hand to prospects. No website needed yet — get internal clarity first.

**Standardize the conversation:**
Brief coaches (15 mins) on why each service exists and who buys it. One coach selling 6 different PT packages = death. Consistency drives conversion and prevents your best coach undercutting your worst.

• **Churn spike in May (12.8%) killed growth; now stabilised but still elevated.** Last 3 months average 6.6% vs prior 3-month 7.8% — improvement, but target 3–4% (you hit it twice). Sep headcount (165) is your highest; **focus Sep–Oct on retention mechanics**: exit-interview data, class-booking friction, peak-time capacity issues. At 165 members, losing 6% monthly = 10 members gone; at £124 Rev/member that's £1,240 monthly churn leakage.

• **Rev/member collapsed Aug (£106) despite 153 active members.** This signals low engagement or payment lag. Sep bounced to £133 — **audit Aug payment timing on GoCardless/Stripe; flag any failed direct debits**. If genuine engagement drop, run a "August slump" analysis: were classes cancelled, staff away, summer holidays? Plan counter-programming (outdoor classes, August challenge, loyalty bonus) for 2027.

• **Last 3 months revenue averaging £19,313 vs prior 3 months £16,032 = +20% YoY trajectory.** You're growing. Next lever: **upsell PT/1-on-1 coaching** (marginal cost near zero if staff-led); **launch class packs or 10-class bundles at 15% premium** (lock cash early, reduce churn psychology). Current membership model isn't extracting enough from 165 members — target £150+ Rev/member by Q1 2027.
